strategy.offer: An online mail-order shop and record label offering physical music releases, books, merchandise, and curated reissues alongside a broad third-party catalog.
strategy.customers: Collectors and fans seeking purchasable physical recordings and related media, especially buyers interested in music beyond the mainstream.
strategy.why_we_win: It argues specialist curation, carefully produced editions, broad in-stock selection, and expanding genre coverage make hard-to-find music easier to discover and buy.
strategy.resources: Long experience in reissuing overlooked music, an established label, an online shop, and a warehouse-backed catalog of over 60,000 items.
strategy.direction: To keep broadening genres, formats, and categories while growing from a specialist label into a wider online destination for physical music media.
